description: ⚠️ [En cours de développement / Non testé] Replaces the default Spotify green (#1DB954) with custom theme accents (Purple, Cyan, Crimson, Gold) resilient across weekly updates.
name: Spicetify Custom Accent Color - Spotify (Experimental)

description: ⚠️ [En cours de développement / Non testé] Removes intrusive Premium upgrade banners, bottom navigation upsell tabs, and promotional carousels for a clean, distraction-free music experience.
name: Spicetify Declutter UI - Spotify (Experimental)

description: ⚠️ [En cours de développement / Non testé] Disables Bob's sprint exhaustion in Robbery Bob, giving unlimited running stamina to escape guards, residents, and guard dogs without slowing down. (Experimental - Not yet tested on device).
name: Unlimited Sprint & Stamina - Robbery Bob (Experimental)

description: ⚠️ [En cours de développement / Non testé] Unlocks all chapters and bonus heist levels in Robbery Bob (Suburbs, Secret Labs, Downtown, Felonious Felines) without requiring 3-star level progression. (Experimental - Not yet tested on device).
name: Unlock All Chapters - Robbery Bob (Experimental)

description: ⚠️ [En cours de développement / Non testé] Unlocks experimental equipment slots, booster upgrades, and datacore matrices in Vector 2 without research token gating. (Experimental - Not yet tested on device).
name: Unlock Gear Matrix - Vector 2 (Experimental)

description: ⚠️ [En cours de développement / Non testé] Unlocks CoinSnap VIP features including unlimited coin identifications, full grading and valuation, collection storage, and disables startup paywall prompts. (Experimental - Not yet tested on device).
name: Unlock VIP (Experimental)

description: Lets you select and copy profile bios. Links still work.
name: CopyBios

description: Sends an audio file as a real voice message, with Discord's own waveform. Needs Android 10 or newer. Turn it on in Venus settings.
name: Custom voice messages

description: Shows spaces instead of dashes in channel names. Only changes how they look.
name: Dashless

description: Stops Discord from reading your Google advertising ID. Always on once patched.
name: Disable advertising identifiers

description: Stops Discord's usage tracking and the analytics events it uploads. Always on once patched.
name: Disable analytics

description: Stops crash reports, screenshots and system logs from being sent to Sentry. Always on once patched.
name: Disable crash reporting

description: Stops AppsFlyer from tracking how you installed the app. Some invite links that open before install may not work.
name: Disable install attribution

description: Stops performance tracking and records of what you tap. Always on once patched.
name: Disable telemetry and touch logging

description: Lets you favourite any image or video from the media viewer.
name: FavouriteAnything

description: Shows file sizes on photos and videos when you attach them.
name: File size on picker

description: Shows your phone's emojis instead of Discord's, in chat, reactions and the emoji picker. Emojis your phone doesn't have stay Discord's.
name: Force system emojis

description: Lets Discord use your phone's font instead of gg sans. Turn it on in Venus settings. Needs Android 9 or newer.
name: Force system font

description: Sends emojis and stickers you can't use as image links. These are links, not real Nitro emojis or stickers.
name: FreeNitro

description: Shows channels you can't open, with a lock and when they were created and last used. It can't show their messages. Turn it on in Venus settings.
name: Hidden Channels

description: Removes the Nitro gift button from the message bar.
name: Hide gift button

description: Hides the Quests promotion above your profile bar, under the server list.
name: Hide Quests promotion

description: Adds a button to jump to the first message in a chat.
name: JumpToTop

description: Double-tap a message to reply, or to edit your own. Tap your own message three times to delete it. Based on Geastures+ by kmmiio99o. Turn it on in Venus settings.
name: Message tap gestures

description: Hides that you're typing. You still see when others type.
name: No typing

description: Keeps deleted messages visible, outlined in red. You can save them for good and choose how many to keep. Turn it on in Venus settings.
name: NoDelete

description: Gives names and mentions without a role color a soft pastel color.
name: Pastelize

description: Shows whether people are on desktop, mobile, web, console or VR, on profiles, in lists and in DMs.
name: PlatformIndicators

description: Completes video, Play and Activity Quests in the background when Discord is open, with no screen or tap. You still claim rewards yourself. Discord may pause Quests on accounts that do this.
name: Quest Completer

description: Skips the "are you sure?" when deleting messages or embeds. Turn it on in Venus settings.
name: QuickDelete

description: Adds a Read all button to the server list, under the Direct Messages button. Choose whether it clears servers, DMs or both.
name: Read All

description: Read and write reviews of users and servers, using the community ReviewDB service (manti.vendicated.dev). Turn it on in Venus settings.
name: ReviewDB

description: Lifts the 60 Hz limit Maps puts on itself, on the app and on the map, so it can run at your screen's full refresh rate (such as 120 Hz). Uses more battery, most of all while navigating. Off by default: switch it on on the Customization screen.
name: 120 refresh rate

description: Adds a 2D / 3D compass switch to the Experimental screen. With it on, tapping the compass in navigate mode switches the map between the tilted 3D view and a flat, north-up 2D map the way Google Maps' does, from any state (following you, panned away, paused), and brings the map back to you. The compass shows a single north arrow in 2D, and the next navigation starts in the mode you used last.
name: 2D / 3D compass

description: Removes the "More from this app" label from the account sheet, and keeps the sheet open when you come back from Settings or Customization or tap "Your profile", instead of dropping back to the map.
name: Account sheet cleanup

description: Builds microG Maps, a separate app (org.ungoogled.android.apps.maps.microg) that signs in to your Google account through microG: saved places and lists, Timeline, location sharing, contributions and push messages. Remove sign-in prompts, Trim account menu and Remove permissions are left out of this build, Offline saved places keeps only its Local saved screen, which copies your account's saved lists to the phone (Pull from Google account), and its icon carries microG's C. Needs microG: MicroG-RE or ReVanced GmsCore. Not for root (mount) installs.
name: Add microG support

description: How far ahead, in metres, Waze warns of police, hazards, crashes, traffic jams and speed cameras. The defaults are the old Waze mods' (CGE); Waze's own are lower for most of them.
name: Alert distances

description: Every mood can be chosen: the ones Waze keeps for higher ranks and the beta moods it hides.
name: All moods

description: Navigation's Default media app (Settings > Navigation) offers every music and podcast app that works with Android Auto, such as Poweramp, not only Spotify, YouTube Music and Pandora.
name: Any media app

description: Adds a Better filters switch to the Experimental screen. With it on, the trail filter's sliders move in finer steps over the same ranges: Rating in 0.1 stars (instead of Any, 3.5, 4 and 4.5), Length in 0.1 mi, Elevation gain in 10 ft, Highest point in 100 ft and Distance away in 1 mi (metric: 0.1 km, 5 m, 50 m, 1 km).
name: Better filters

description: Reworks the offline area picker: zooming out really selects more instead of being shrunk to Google's size cap, the box can be resized by dragging its edges and corners, a large area is split into several downloads whose true total size is shown, and areas already downloaded are drawn on the map. Can be turned off on the Customization screen.
name: Better offline maps

description: Adds a Better tracking switch to the Experimental screen. With it on, recordings work the way Gaia GPS records: the phone's GPS directly with every fix delivered live (no Play services batching), fixes worse than 65 m or physically impossible dropped, points kept 3 m apart, no trail-biased smoothing, and elevation converted to sea level and counted in 2 m steps.
name: Better tracking

description: Bigger digits on the speedometer, and on the speed limit sign beside it, so they can be read at a glance.
name: Bigger speedometer

options.description: The "mph" or "km/h" under the speed. Waze: 12.
options.title: Unit label (dp)
Speed limit sign digits, 100 and over (sp)

description: Uses a white AllTrails logo on black for the launcher icon and the splash screen, instead of green on dark green, so this build is easy to tell apart from the stock app.
name: Black icon

description: AMOLED-black theme. Pins Maps' own dark mode and its separate navigation colour scheme, and remaps colour resources, drawable fills and draw-time paints so no surface is left grey.
name: Black theme

description: Chromium-coloured flat map pin on every in-app product logo and the search bar's leading icon.
name: Blue pin

description: Makes Maps' bundled Play services signature and availability checks always pass, so it runs re-signed and with Play services disabled or absent, and lets it load tiles, search and routing by sending Google's own package and certificate in the identity headers the Maps backend checks. Where Play services rejects the re-signed app, Maps degrades instead of crashing.
name: Bypass Play Services checks

description: Sets the launcher and in-app app name.
name: Change app name

options.description: The name shown under the launcher icon and in the app switcher. Left at Ungoogled Maps, Add microG support names the app microG Maps instead.
options.title: App name

description: Installs alongside stock AllTrails under its own package name.
name: Change package name

options.description: The package name to install under. Must be a valid Android package name.
options.title: Package name

description: Installs alongside stock Google Maps under its own package name. On by default, because stock Maps comes built into most phones and cannot be replaced by a patched copy.
name: Change package name

options.description: The package name to install under. Must be a valid Android package name. Left at org.ungoogled.android.apps.maps, Add microG support installs under org.ungoogled.android.apps.maps.microg instead.
options.title: Package name

description: Adds a Customization row under Settings on the account sheet, with switches for the patches here that can be turned back off inside the app.
name: Customization screen

description: Adds an Experimental row to your profile's menu, under Edit profile and Share profile, that opens an Experimental screen.
name: Experimental screen

description: Waze's dark mode in true black for AMOLED screens: the app's dark backgrounds are black, and with Black night map the night map's background too. Roads, labels, buttons and text keep their colours.
name: Full black

options.description: The night map's background black as well. Skipped by Morphe Manager 1.35 and other patcher 1.15+ builds, which would crash Waze when the map opens; patch with Morphe Desktop to get it.
options.title: Black night map

description: Removes the sponsored pins on the map and on Android Auto, the full-screen ads shown while you are stopped, and the ad statistics Waze sends.
name: Hide ads

description: Hides promoted map pins and "Sponsored" search results, Gemini's AI summaries ("Know before you go" and the review summary), the row of businesses under an address on its place sheet, the home tab's Explore feed and the Explore / Contribute / You tabs. Each can be switched back on on the Customization screen.
name: Hide ads and clutter

description: Uses the flat multicolour pin Maps had before the 2025 gradient icon as the launcher icon and on the screen Maps opens with. With Add microG support, microG's C sits in the pin's circle.
name: Legacy icon

description: Adds a Location source choice to the Customization screen: Android's own location providers, microG's (microg Services) or Google Play services' fused provider. With Android, neither is ever asked for a location. A source that is missing or disabled is never used, so location keeps working without it. Also keeps the network (Wi-Fi/cell) provider registered when no fused provider answers, instead of GPS only, so a fix does not go stale indoors.
name: Location provider toggle

options.description: The location source Maps starts with. On: the fused provider -- Google Play services', or microG's in microG Maps -- whenever it is installed and enabled, Android's own providers otherwise. Off: Android's own providers. Can be changed later on the Customization screen.
options.title: Default to Play services location

description: The old Waze mods' map skin, as changes to Waze's own: bigger map labels, a wider navigation arrow head and a warm day background. The night background is Full black's. Skipped by Morphe Manager 1.35 and other patcher 1.15+ builds, which would crash Waze when the map opens; patch with Morphe Desktop to get it.
name: Map skin

options.description: As a multiple of the arrow's tail width. Waze: 3.0.
options.title: Navigation arrow head width

description: How far ahead Android Auto gives its heads-up, and how long a jam must last before the traffic bar shows it. The defaults are the old Waze mods' (Chuppito).
name: Navigation distances

description: Turns off conversational reporting, Waze's Gemini voice assistant for reports, together with its activation dialog, tips and onboarding.
name: No AI reporting

description: Keeps Google Assistant out of Waze: no Assistant button, onboarding or settings entry, whatever Waze's server enables for your region.
name: No Google Assistant

description: Save places without a Google account, kept only on the phone: Save opens Maps' own "Place saved" sheet (Want to go, Travel plans, Starred places, Favorites, your own lists, a note), and a "Local saved" row on the account sheet rebuilds Maps' You tab -- your recent places, your lists and labels (Home, Work, your own) -- with export and import (backup file, KML, Google Takeout's saved lists and Saved Places.json, several files or the whole Takeout .zip at once). It also has a Timeline: where the phone has been, grouped into days and visits, kept only on the phone, with GPX export. Recording is off until switched on there; it shows a notification while it runs. With Add microG support, Maps' own Save keeps syncing to your account and Local saved instead copies the account's saved lists to the phone (Pull from Google account).
name: Offline saved places

description: Brings the Pixel-only power saving mode to every phone: while driving with navigation, press the power button and Maps shows only key information such as the next turn on a black screen. Turn it on or off in Settings > Navigation > Power saving mode. Pixels that have it built in keep Google's own version unless Power saving mode is turned on in Power Saving Options, a row on the account sheet under Customization, which also has: a navigation button that opens the power saving screen without locking the phone, switching to it by itself when idle, a speedometer on it, a lower frame rate, and its black map in navigation or all over Maps.
name: Power saving mode

description: Adds a Proxy screen to Customization that sends Maps' own traffic, map data included, through an HTTP proxy -- for example Orbot's (127.0.0.1:8118) to use Tor. Map data never falls back to a direct connection: if the proxy stops, Maps stops loading. Needs a recent Play services network engine (Cronet); Maps warns when it cannot take the proxy.
name: Proxy

description: Squares off rounded corners across the UI, including the two round navigation buttons.
name: Rectangle shapes

description: Adds a Remember filter states switch to the Experimental screen. With it on, the trail filters you set (length, elevation, rating, difficulty, activities, features and the rest, but not Distance away) stay set when you go back to the home screen and after the app restarts, instead of resetting.
name: Remember filters

description: Removes permissions that only serve Google-account features or Google's data collection: background location, physical activity, contacts, microphone (voice search stops working), camera (Lens and Live View stop working), car speed, advertising ID, push messages and Google services settings. Left out with Add microG support, whose account features need them.
name: Remove permissions

description: Removes Google's sign-in prompts: the first-launch "Make it your map" page, the search screen's "Tired of typing?" card and the account sheet's "Sign in" pill. Tapping "Your profile" (or the pill, where it still shows) answers with a "Can't sign in" toast instead of nothing. Left out with Add microG support, which signs in.
name: Remove sign-in prompts

description: Points the Firebase Installations and Play services compliance check-ins at an unresolvable host, stops every ad impression and click ping from being sent, and deregisters Google's logging, performance-monitoring, survey and Location History libraries and the on-device federated-learning services. With Add microG support, Firebase Installations and Location History are left alone, so Timeline, account sync and push messages keep working.
name: Remove telemetry

description: Turns on Waze's own switch for correcting the speed limit from the speedometer, the old mods' "Report speed limit". Waze's server keeps it off; what it shows is not verified here.
name: Report speed limit

description: Plays the speed camera sound for every camera, not only when you are over the speed limit.
name: Speed camera sound at any speed

description: Chimes and shows a note when a speed or red light camera is coming up ahead, and puts the cameras on the map, from OpenStreetMap. Off until turned on in Waze Features, a row on the account sheet, because it downloads the cameras near you from an OpenStreetMap server.
name: Speed cameras

description: Turns speed camera and police alerts back on in the countries where Waze's server switches them off. Warning of speed cameras is against the law in some of those countries.
name: Speed cameras everywhere

description: The style of the speed limit sign beside the speedometer, whatever the country.
name: Speed limit sign

description: Plays a chime when your speed passes the speed limit during navigation, as Waze does. Maps itself only turns its speedometer red. When it chimes is chosen in Waze Features, a row on the account sheet.
name: Speeding chime

description: Adds a Theme choice to the Experimental screen: Follow phone, Light, Dark or AMOLED black (dark with pure black backgrounds). AllTrails itself only follows the phone.
name: Theme

description: Removes Your Timeline, Location sharing, Your data in Maps and Help & feedback from the account sheet. Left out with Add microG support, whose account features need them.
name: Trim account menu

description: Adds +, − and reset tiles during turn-by-turn that change the navigation zoom while the camera keeps following the car.
name: Zoom controls in navigation

description: Adds more ways to save: pick the video quality, save full-size photos, the sound on its own or a photo post as one video, hold a profile picture or story to save it, and save a story from its share sheet. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Downloads.
name: Advanced downloads

description: Shows the Duet and Stitch buttons on videos whose creator turned them off, so you can still make one. TikTok may still refuse some videos or the upload. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Share sheet.
name: Allow Duet and Stitch

description: Lets screenshots, screen recordings and Circle to Search work on TikTok screens that would otherwise come out black. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App, then restart TikTok.
name: Allow screenshots and Circle to Search

description: Shows the date a video was posted next to the creator's name, so you can tell how old it is. It can also show the exact time, or dates on profile grids. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
name: Always show publish date

description: Posts every video you upload in HD, as if you'd turned on TikTok's own HD upload setting each time. Videos TikTok doesn't count as high quality post as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.
name: Always upload in HD

description: Makes TikTok's dark mode backgrounds pure black, or a dark color you pick in this patch's options. Black lets OLED screens switch those pixels off. Light mode doesn't change. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it undoes it.
name: AMOLED dark theme

options.description: Pick a color, or type a solid color code like #000000. Black lets OLED screens turn those pixels off completely.
options.title: Dark background color

description: Asks for your fingerprint, face or PIN before TikTok opens, and again when you come back after a time you pick, so nobody else can open it on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
name: App lock

description: Moves on to the next video by itself when one ends, so you can watch hands-free. It can also turn on TikTok's auto scroll in search results. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback.
name: Automatic video advance

description: Adds buttons on videos to block the creator, hide them only on your phone, or block the sound, so you can get rid of what you don't want in one tap. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
name: Block author button

description: Gives TikTok an empty contact list when it tries to read your phone's contacts, so it can't use them to suggest friends. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
name: Block contact list access

description: Gives TikTok an empty list when it asks which apps are on your phone, so it learns less about you. Opening another app from TikTok still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
name: Block installed app scanning

description: Removes the files TikTok uses to pass videos on to other viewers through your phone's internet connection. The app gets about 3.5 MB smaller. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it brings them back.
name: Block P2P video relay

description: Lets you stop TikTok's popups, like friend suggestions and offers. Each one joins a checklist after it first appears, and once ticked it won't come back. Sign-in, age and verification screens are never blocked. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
name: Block popups

description: Stops TikTok's "Videos you might like" notifications about popular videos it picked for you. Messages, comments, likes and posts from people you follow still come through. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.
name: Block suggested video notifications

description: Shows a small mark in the top corner while TikTok is using the camera or microphone, so you always know when it is. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
name: Camera and microphone indicator

description: Shows a name you choose under the app icon, so the patched TikTok is easy to tell apart from another copy. Type the name in this patch's options. Inside the app it still says TikTok.
name: Change app name

options.description: The name shown under the app icon, up to 50 characters.
options.title: App name

description: Adds a note to Hushfeed's diagnostic report about how far a comment got when it fails to post, which helps track down comments that vanish without an error. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
name: Comment publish diagnostics

description: Fixes comments that TikTok sometimes drops without any message, so the comment you send actually posts. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
name: Comment send fix

description: Shows TikTok's full comment sort menu on every video, with hot, newest, media and creator options, even when your account only got a cut-down version. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.
name: Comment sort controls

description: Hides comments with words you pick or from accounts you pick, and adds a search box for a video's comments. It can also make links tappable and show poll results before you vote. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Comments.
name: Comment tools

description: Asks for a second tap before Follow, a like, or a quick repost goes through, so a stray tap doesn't count. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
name: Confirm feed interactions

description: Lets you long-press a bio to copy it, and adds share sheet buttons that copy a username, user ID or video ID. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > App.
name: Copy bio and IDs
